notes.title: Release 0.9.2
notes.notes:
Release Notes:

[b]Enhanced Chapter Selection Menu:[/b] The chapter selection menu has received a significant update, allowing players to choose specific cutscenes or chapters to replay at their convenience.

[b]Improved Game Progress Saving:[/b] Game progress will now be saved before the end of a scene. Previously, progress was saved when the next scene started.

[b]New Tutorials Added:[/b] We have introduced tutorials for running and zooming. These tutorials will appear after the first chapter: Monique's Apartment, provided players haven't already used these actions extensively.

[b]Convenient "Continue" Button:[/b] A "Continue" button has been added to certain scenes, such as the intro, replacing the previous method of progressing if the player right clicked. This change aims to eliminate confusion for players.

[b]Staircase Bug Fixes:[/b] Several issues related to navigating stairs have been identified and resolved.

[b]Changed Cutscene and Chapter Names:[/b] We have revamped and reorganized the names of cutscenes and chapters.

[b]Numerous Tweaks and Polishes:[/b] We've fine-tuned and fixed various aspects of the game.

notes.title: Release 0.8.3.1
notes.notes:
This release includes the following changes:

	•	Resolved an issue where players were unable to complete the Prison chapter.
	•	Improved the smoothness of transitions between rooms on the same layer.
	•	Corrected an animation error that occurred when entering the telephone room through the grate in the Prison.
	•	Fixed a bug that caused Monique to repeatedly run up and down the stairs.

You can find the release number of the game you are playing in Settings.

Thank you for testing Midnight Girl. We hope you enjoy the improvements in this release!

notes.title: Release 0.8.2.2
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes[/b]

	•	Fixed several bugs that caused Monique to get stuck on interaction items, such as the fusebox in the Powerstation.
	•	Added 16:9 cameras for chapter 5 to 8
	•	Fixed a bug that caused Monique to get stuck behind an invisible border in the floor inside the church in the Monastery Chapter.
	•	Fixed Icons that were visible in wrong places.
	•	Fixed a problem that allowed players to use inventory objects on open doors, such as the electric door in the metro station.
	•	Added more explanations when players try to use inventory objects on the wrong items.
	•	Fixed a bug on stairs where Monique sometimes turned in the wrong direction at the top of the stairs.

I hope these fixes will improve your gameplay experience. Let us know if you encounter any further issues.

notes.title: Release Notes 0.8.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed Issues:
	•	Fixed a bug that previously caused players to get stuck on the stairs leading to the Shunter in chapter 5.
	•	Adjusted all texts in chapter 1-8
	•	Fixed a problem that sometimes caused the camera to get stuck after using the inventory
	•	Fixed multiple problems with jumping graphics related to the 2D parallax, making it work as expected now.
	•	Resolved an issue with a disappearing shovel, which players encountered earlier in chapter 7.
	•	Improved audio fade between levels.
	•	Added a new room to the Catacombs (Chapter 7),
	•	Adjusted puzzles in the Catacombs (Chapter 7) to improve the overall gameplay experience.
	•	Fixed several problems on the stairs, which was a source of frustration for players.
	•	Fixed sounds that previously did not work after the intro cutscenes
	•	Addressed many other issues that were present in the previous release.
